ValidationRule.description: To ensure that all QAC Credit Assets records should not be modified after it is created.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_QAC_Credits_Asset_Cannot_be_Modified__c, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Agency_Credit', NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED( AccountId ), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(Asset_Year__c) , ISCHANGED(Active__c) , ISCHANGED(Total_Acquired_Credits__c) , ISCHANGED(Total_Consumed_Credits__c) , ISCHANGED(Total_Outstanding_Credits__c) , ISCHANGED(Description) , ISCHANGED(PurchaseDate) , ISCHANGED(UsageEndDate) ), NOT(OR($Profile.Name = "QAC API Integration Profile", $Profile.Name = "Data Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Qantas Service Lightning", $Profile.Name = "Qantas Agency Connect and Agency Sales" )),NOT( $User.Id = $CustomMetadata.QAC_Agency_Credit_Detail__mdt.TrevorWorganUserID.UserID__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot modify Agency Credit Asset records.
